reflection.text:
The run was dominated by very strong nuclear-shape signals: frac_multinucleate_proxy z +8.0 to +10.9 and nuc_eccentricity z ~7.5-7.9 at 0.3, 1 and 10 uM (e2, e3, e8) with reduced density flagged visually as Aurora/Eg5-like (e4). That was wrong because the atlas majority was not decisive: mean similarities were tied between Protein synthesis, Epithelial and Cholesterol-lowering, the microscopist cue directly contradicted Protein synthesis, and the multinucleate proxy was never explained by that hypothesis. The key acquisition error was order: I acquired the strongest well w_443392cc3e at 1 uM with 847 cells and z +10.9 (e8) after the first atlas but submitted Protein synthesis p=0.50 (e14) without re-classifying it, forcing the review-requested e15 comparison that flipped to Epithelial 4/10 versus Protein synthesis 3/10.

## Reflection

The run was dominated by very strong nuclear-shape signals: frac_multinucleate_proxy z +8.0 to +10.9 and nuc_eccentricity z ~7.5-7.9 at 0.3, 1 and 10 uM (e2, e3, e8) with reduced density flagged visually as Aurora/Eg5-like (e4). That was wrong because the atlas majority was not decisive: mean similarities were tied between Protein synthesis, Epithelial and Cholesterol-lowering, the microscopist cue directly contradicted Protein synthesis, and the multinucleate proxy was never explained by that hypothesis. The key acquisition error was order: I acquired the strongest well w_443392cc3e at 1 uM with 847 cells and z +10.9 (e8) after the first atlas but submitted Protein synthesis p=0.50 (e14) without re-classifying it, forcing the review-requested e15 comparison that flipped to Epithelial 4/10 versus Protein synthesis 3/10.

In hindsight the persistent large-nucleus tail, eccentric apposed nuclei, and dose-persistent clustering fit epithelial adhesion/packing mimicking multinucleation in segmentation better than true Aurora polyploidy or global translation loss. I correctly lowered to p=0.35 after e15 but still did not switch, overweighting the earlier count.

What was right:
- Retained Aurora kinase inhibitors and Eg5 inhibitors in the differential after e4 visual description and e2/e3/e8 high frac_multinucleate_proxy and eccentricity signals instead of dismissing mitotic hypotheses outright.
- Correctly deprioritized microtubule stabilizers/destabilizers because tub_mean was preserved/increased (e12 rho +0.80) without a classic tubulin collapse at high doses (e2, e3).
- Re-tested the strongest well alone in e15 and appropriately lowered confidence from 0.50 to 0.35 when it returned Epithelial 4/10 versus Protein synthesis 3/10.

What was wrong or missed:
- Overweighted the first atlas count 5/10 Protein synthesis in e5 while ignoring tied mean similarities and the competing 3/10 Epithelial signal that foreshadowed the truth.
- Failed to explain frac_multinucleate_proxy z +8.0 to +10.9 and nuc_eccentricity z 7.5-7.9 (e2, e3, e8) under a Protein synthesis hypothesis and dismissed the e4 microscopist Aurora/Eg5 call that was closer to a mitotic/clustering phenotype.

- Submitted p=0.50 in e14 despite unresolved atlas-versus-morphology contradiction flagged in review, i.e. over-calibration.
